description:
https://www.playstation.com/games/synth-riders/

Level UP with Synth Riders: Progression System Brings Persistent Stats, and a More Guided Experience

Coming up to 8 years since its release, Synth Riders continues to push forward with one of its most ambitious updates to date. Today, Kluge Interactive is rolling out a comprehensive Progression System, a feature designed to recognize the dedication of long-time players while making the game more approachable for newcomers.

This update marks a major pivot in how players experience Synth Riders, adding persistent player stats, levels, and more features that extend beyond individual jam sessions and into the broader community. It’s a first for the title, and a testament to the team’s commitment to meaningful feature development even amidst turbulence in the broader VR ecosystem, something many developers and publications alike have recently observed.
